name: build

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Prime the caches every Monday
    - cron: 0 1 * * MON

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  test:
    name: test (${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "5"
          - os: macos-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "5"
          - os: windows-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "5"
            # alcotest-async depends on core_unix, which does not support
            # Windows.
            opam-files: ./alcotest.opam ./alcotest-lwt.opam ./alcotest-mirage.opam
            dune-flags: --only-packages alcotest,alcotest-lwt,alcotest-mirage
          # alcotest-async lower bound
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "4.14"

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Set git to use LF
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          git config --global core.eol lf

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set-up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: lts/*

      - name: Set-up Binaryen
        if: ${{ matrix.runtest }}
        uses: Aandreba/setup-binaryen@v1.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Set-up OCaml ${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: ${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}

      - run: opam install ${{ matrix.opam-files || '.' }} --deps-only --with-test

      # The aliases are quoted because PowerShell, the default shell on
      # Windows, reads a bare @name as splatting the variable $name.
      - run: opam exec -- dune build ${{ matrix.dune-flags }} '@install' '@check' '@runtest'

      # The js_of_ocaml backend does not work on Windows yet: absolute paths
      # are mangled and caml_unix_filedescr_of_channel is missing.
      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam install js_of_ocaml-compiler

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam exec -- dune build '@runtest-js'

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam install wasm_of_ocaml-compiler

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam exec -- dune build @runtest-wasm
        env:
          WASM_OF_OCAML: true

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam exec -- sh test/wasm-downstream/run.sh

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set-up OCaml 5
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: "5"

      - name: Lint opam files
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml/lint-opam@v3

      - name: Check formatting
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml/lint-fmt@v3

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
